integrity: The proof independently derives intrinsic facet-normal lengths from orthogonal-projection symmetry and trace, then proves sharpness and center uniqueness by summing all coordinate clearances. The source dimensions and facet descriptions were checked in the primary full text. Exact finite linear-algebra replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns order-\(3\), equal-side stochastic tensor polytopes with \(n\ge3\) in the standard Frobenius metric. It does not determine circumradii, extremal ellipsoids, or inradii for nonuniform multiway transportation margins. The low-dimensional case \(n=2\) is excluded from the all-distinct-facets formulation.
title: Line- and plane-stochastic tensor polytopes are tangential with exact inradii
